overview: The committee finalized the June municipal newsletter and established a rotation for councilors to author future editions through the end of the year. Members also coordinated logistics and outreach strategies for upcoming hybrid neighborhood ward meetings and scheduled a preliminary discussion of the noise ordinance for mid-September.

items.title: City Newsletter Review
items.summary: Approved the June newsletter draft with revisions to include links to recent personnel and compensation ordinances and a summary of Department of Public Works paving activity.

items.title: Newsletter Production Schedule
items.summary: Adopted a monthly rotation schedule for councilors to draft the municipal newsletter from September through December 2026.

items.title: Neighborhood Ward Meetings Planning
items.summary: Finalized logistics for upcoming hybrid neighborhood ward meetings, including coordination with Medford Community Media and a multi-channel communication plan involving city departments and community organizations.

items.title: Noise Ordinance Update
items.summary: Postponed the noise ordinance discussion to a mid-September meeting to ensure sufficient time for public notice.
